field_descriptions.aggregate_rating: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.
field_descriptions.area_served: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.
field_descriptions.audience: An intended audience, i.e. a group for whom something was created.
field_descriptions.available_channel: A means of accessing the service (e.g. a phone bank, a web site, a location, etc.).
field_descriptions.award: An award won by or for this item.
field_descriptions.brand: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.
field_descriptions.broker: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller.  In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange.  If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.
field_descriptions.category: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.
field_descriptions.has_certification: Certification information about a product, organization, service, place, or person.
field_descriptions.has_offer_catalog: Indicates an OfferCatalog listing for this Organization, Person, or Service.
field_descriptions.hours_available: The hours during which this service or contact is available.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.is_related_to: A pointer to another, somehow related product (or multiple products).
field_descriptions.is_similar_to: A pointer to another, functionally similar product (or multiple products).
field_descriptions.offers: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.
field_descriptions.produces: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.
field_descriptions.provider: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.
field_descriptions.provider_mobility: Indicates the mobility of a provided service (e.g. 'static', 'dynamic').
field_descriptions.service_area: The geographic area where the service is provided.
field_descriptions.service_audience: The audience eligible for this service.
field_descriptions.service_output: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.
field_descriptions.service_type: The type of service being offered, e.g. veterans' benefits, emergency relief, etc.
field_descriptions.slogan: A slogan or motto associated with the item.
